summary: CVB Financial Corp. (CVBF) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Heritage Commerce Corp, effective April 17, 2026, under a merger agreement dated December 17, 2025. Heritage shareholders received 0.65 CVBF shares per Heritage share (Exchange Ratio). CVBF is the surviving entity after Heritage merged into CVBF; Heritage Bank subsequently merged into Citizens Business Bank. Outstanding Heritage options were cashed out, and restricted stock/RSU awards were accelerated, with continuing CVBF employees receiving substituted CVBF RSUs. The all-stock deal creates a combined California banking franchise. No break fee or premium % disclosed. Watch for post-close integration execution and CVBF share price performance as risk-arb unwinds.
